notes.title: New Version
notes.notes:
So after a while (and some personal stuff), I've finally got a new version of Labyrinthian I'm somewhat happy with (all things considered). I'll admit, it's still not quite what I had wanted when I originally started out making it, but It was a great learning experience (as will hopefully be evident between the original and the remake version). 

The original version is still there as a separate launch option (The second one. They're both called "Labyrinthian". Not sure why...)

All things considered, I feel much better now that I have this out and done, and can move on to other potential projects. I'll see you guys in the future (hopefully...)
